religion_note: Hankook Research, 2025 Religion Perception Survey: religious population and religious activity (Weekly Report No. 358-3, 3 December 2025), religion by residence region. A survey of adults, not a census: the religion question pooled from the 22 waves of Hankook Research's biweekly web panel run January to November 2025, 23,000 respondents aged 18 and over, weighted by region, sex and age to the resident register. Whole percentages as printed; 'other religions' is the printed 'has a religion' less Protestant, Catholic and Buddhist. This province is the only province in the report's residence region 'Seoul'. The 2015 census asked religion and KOSIS publishes it by province behind a registered key; that figure replaces this one when read.
